card.text: WASP-64 b was found in 2012 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "WASP-64"
sources.quote: It is a G7 class main-sequence star, orbited by a planet WASP-64b.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around Atakoraka. Its orbit and size follow Gillon et al. 2013's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Gillon et al. 2013

sources.quote: It is younger than the Sun at 3.6±1.6 billion years, and it has a metal abundance similar to the Sun.
